rationale: Public broadcaster economy section: free, archive-stable national coverage of procurement disputes and state contracts.
Largest SI job board; bank/vendor implementation postings are an early proxy for awarded payments/core-banking contracts.
Second major SI board with IT category and per-company hiring feeds for NLB/OTP etc.
Third general SI job board adding staffing-agency postings; lower yield but cheap incremental coverage.
Official ESS vacancy registry with legal publication duty for public/state-owned employers; standalone despite gov.si siblings.
First-party careers feed of the largest SI/SEE banking group; exposes regional roll-out programmes.
State-owned development bank careers feed cross-referable with its eJN procurement obligations.
Small private bank careers page, often the only public trace of a system change.
High-value implementation-role and go-live signal but login-gated and ToS-restricted; human must clear access.
Aggregator useful once to map which boards/ATS each bank uses, then monitor those directly.
Flagship SI IT conference programme; bank+vendor co-presentations disclose live payments/banking projects, with per-year archives.
Association event page mainly points to the DSI conference site already tracked; mine once for other specialist events.
Bank association press stream and annual conference carry sector-level payment-infrastructure programmes preceding procurement.
Training calendar is a section of zbs-giz.si already monitored via the news/press stream; useful sub-feed, not standalone.
Distinct journal on its own subdomain; practitioner articles name banking/payments platforms being introduced.
National card/instant-payment processor (Flik); news and annual reports sit upstream of every bank's payments procurement.
Domestic payments/e-banking vendor newsroom and reference list; classic post-award disclosure when the bank stays silent.
Conference series agendas and sponsor lists map vendor-bank relationships; recurring output.
Single 2026 event page on delo.si conference arm; value unclear beyond one agenda — recheck for a durable conference index.
Long-running SI finance conference; agendas and partner lists identify fintech/payment vendors courting SI institutions.
Single video URL rather than the channel; re-point to the ZBS channel feed before approving as a monitored source.
Investigative outlet whose failure reporting retrospectively confirms bank IT migrations and suppliers.
First-party public-calls page of the largest SI bank — direct A2 procurement signal.
